sentence: This project builds a memory management system that helps embedded systems use memory better across the application and system stack.
This project studies how nanoparticles coated with an ionic liquid stick to blood cells and what that does to the cell membrane.
This project builds a control system for plastic injection molding that predicts part quality and adjusts machine settings automatically.
This project identifies young stars close to Earth, works out their ages, and searches some of them for planets using direct imaging.
This project studies fast radio bursts, using computer models to find out whether they all come from the same kind of object.
This project builds a deep learning tool that finds and labels genes in the genomes of many organisms, including insects, plants, and animals.
This project develops and studies instruction in quantum science and quantum computing for precollege science.
This project identifies chemicals released from end-of-life tires as they age and studies how those chemicals behave in the environment.
This project builds computational tools that use machine learning to find markers in genome assemblies, starting with bats, to work out relationships among living things.
This project develops electrochemical microscopy methods to work out the steps of oxygen electrocatalysis on clean single-crystal metals.
This project studies how single molecules bind at reactive sites on surfaces and how that binding affects nearby sites, using imaging and computer calculations.
This project assesses a light-activated treatment that combines fluorescence-guided surgery with photodynamic therapy to help destroy cancer cells left after surgery.
This project studies how three proteins move coenzyme Q to the parts of a cell where it is needed.
This project builds machine learning methods that find genomic patterns linked to how bacteria adapt to different environments.
This project studies how an adversary can change reward signals to trick learning-based controllers and builds ways to detect such attacks.
This project studies how the shape and gene layout of nanoparticles made from synthetic DNA affect their ability to make proteins in cells.
